reports.title: Answers Analyzed
reports.query:
MATCH (a:Answer)
WHERE a.sentiment_label IS NOT NULL
RETURN count(a) AS Total

reports.title: Sentiment Distribution (Bar)
reports.query:
MATCH (i:Interview)
RETURN i.sentiment_label AS Sentiment, count(i) AS Interviews

reports.title: Sentiment Share (Pie)
reports.query:
MATCH (i:Interview)
RETURN i.sentiment_label AS Sentiment, count(i) AS Interviews

reports.title: Dominant Emotions Breakdown
reports.query:
MATCH (i:Interview)-[:EXPRESSES_EMOTION]->(e:Emotion)
RETURN e.name AS Emotion, count(i) AS Interviews

reports.title: Interview Overview & Sentiment Summary
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)-[:EXPLORES_TOPIC]->(t:Topic)
RETURN u.name AS Participant,
       t.name AS Topic,
       i.sentiment_label AS Sentiment,
       round(i.sentiment_score, 3) AS Score,
       i.dominant_emotion AS Emotion,
       i.communication_tone AS Tone,
       i.confidence_level AS Confidence,
       i.overview AS Overview
ORDER BY i.analyzed_at DESC

reports.title: Mini-Graph 1: Topics, Themes & Emotions
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[r1:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)-[r2:EXPLORES_TOPIC]->(t:Topic)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r3:HIGHLIGHTS_THEME]->(th:Theme)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r4:EXPRESSES_EMOTION]->(e:Emotion)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r5:HAS_OVERALL_SENTIMENT]->(s:Sentiment)
RETURN u, r1, i, r2, t, r3, th, r4, e, r5, s

reports.title: Mini-Graph 2: Answers & Keywords Network
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[r1:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)-[r2:HAS_ANSWER]->(a:Answer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r3:MENTIONS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r4:HAS_SENTIMENT]->(s:Sentiment)
RETURN u, r1, i, r2, a, r3, k, r4, s
LIMIT 60

reports.title: Mini-Graph 3: Pain Points & Recommendations Map
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[r1:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r2:REVEALS_PAIN_POINT]->(p:PainPoint)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r3:SUGGESTS_RECOMMENDATION]->(rec:Recommendation)
RETURN u, r1, i, r2, p, r3, rec

reports.title: Answers, Per-Turn Sentiment & Extracted Keywords
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)-[:HAS_ANSWER]->(a:Answer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:MENTIONS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword)
RETURN u.name AS Participant,
       a.index AS Turn,
       a.source AS Queue,
       a.question AS Question,
       a.answer AS Answer,
       coalesce(a.sentiment_label, 'skipped') AS Sentiment,
       round(coalesce(a.sentiment_score, 0.0), 3) AS Score,
       collect(k.phrase) AS Keywords
ORDER BY Participant, Turn

reports.title: Themes, Pain Points & Actionable Recommendations
reports.query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:PARTICIPATED_IN]->(i:Interview)-[:EXPLORES_TOPIC]->(t:Topic)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:HIGHLIGHTS_THEME]->(th:Theme)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:REVEALS_PAIN_POINT]->(p:PainPoint)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:SUGGESTS_RECOMMENDATION]->(r:Recommendation)
RETURN u.name AS Participant,
       t.name AS Topic,
       collect(DISTINCT th.name) AS Themes,
       collect(DISTINCT p.text) AS PainPoints,
       collect(DISTINCT r.text) AS Recommendations
ORDER BY Participant

reports.title: Top Recurring Keywords Across Answers
reports.query:
MATCH (t:Topic)<-[:EXPLORES_TOPIC]-(:Interview)-[:HAS_ANSWER]->(a:Answer)-[:MENTIONS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword)
RETURN k.phrase AS Keyword,
       count(DISTINCT a) AS Mentions,
       round(avg(a.sentiment_score), 3) AS AvgSentimentScore,
       collect(DISTINCT t.name) AS Topics
ORDER BY Mentions DESC, Keyword ASC
LIMIT 25

reports.title: Topic Aggregated Sentiment & Emotions
reports.query:
MATCH (t:Topic)<-[:EXPLORES_TOPIC]-(i:Interview)
RETURN t.name AS Topic,
       count(i) AS Interviews,
       round(avg(i.sentiment_score), 3) AS AvgSentimentScore,
       collect(DISTINCT i.sentiment_label) AS Sentiments,
       collect(DISTINCT i.dominant_emotion) AS Emotions
ORDER BY Interviews DESC
